# Link previews (WhatsApp, iMessage, Slack, Facebook) fetch this URL and
# the og:image. The hosting platform falls back to index.html for any file
# that does not exist on disk, so without this file a crawler asking for
# /robots.txt receives a 200 HTML page instead of a policy.
#
# The page itself carries <meta name="robots" content="noindex, nofollow">,
# which is about SEARCH indexing, not fetching. Crawlers must be allowed to
# fetch the page for the share preview to render at all.
User-agent: *
Allow: /
